summary: Tested creator-only in-app unread notifications for 'Segnalazioni e richieste'. Found and FIXED a blocking frontend compile error in Layout.jsx (line 280 merged/corrupted: `}, [isSuper, user]); && (user?.organizations?.length || 0) > 1;` – the `const multiOrg = !isSuper` line was lost, the whole app failed to compile). After fix: backend 8/8 pytest pass (internal note no unread, public reply/close/reopen set unread for creator only, counts tickets not messages, SA GET and other member /read don't mark, creator GET alone doesn't mark, /read marks, closed_at+final message saved, member ticket B isolated, cross-org GET 404 and count 0). Frontend desktop 1920 + mobile 390: red badge '1' in footer link (expanded, collapsed, mobile drawer), list pill 'Da leggere' + highlight + sorted on top, opening detail removes pill & badge without reload, polling picks up new SA reply (~27s), window focus refreshes badge, logout/login and reload keep correct count.

minor.issue: Cross-org user (or nonexistent id) gets 200 {marked:false} instead of 404 (no data leak, no state change; spec said 404). org_mark_read doesn't call _org_ticket first.

ui_bugs.issue: Syntax error at line 280 broke the whole frontend build (FIXED by tester by restoring `const multiOrg = !isSuper && (user?.organizations?.length || 0) > 1;`)

integration_issues.flow: Tickets list while page is open
integration_issues.issue: When the sidebar badge refreshes via focus event, the list on /segnalazioni is not refreshed (only on its own 30s poll), so badge shows 1 while list shows no 'Da leggere' pill/stale status for up to 30s. Consider listening to focus/'tickets:unread-changed' in the list too.

issues: 'Da leggere' pill doesn't fit in 80px Ticket column and overlaps/hides the 'Apertura' date (e.g. '14/10/2026' covered)
iubenda floating preferences button (bottom-left) intercepts clicks on sidebar-toggle when collapsed - user can't re-expand the sidebar by normal click
No unread indicator on mobile-menu-button/header; badge only visible after opening the drawer (enhancement)

action_items: Verify Layout.jsx line ~280 fix (tester restored lost multiOrg line) - frontend did not compile before
Widen Ticket column or move 'Da leggere' pill so it doesn't overlap Apertura date
Optional: make POST /api/tickets/{id}/read return 404 for tickets outside caller org
Optional: refresh tickets list on focus / tickets:unread-changed; fix iubenda float overlapping collapsed sidebar toggle; add unread dot on mobile menu button
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx had a corrupted edit (lost line) - check for other merge damage after edits
org_mark_read skips _org_ticket existence check (returns 200 for any id)
Backend logic in tickets.py is clean: unread computed server-side, creator_unread popped from responses, index on (org_id, created_by.user_id, creator_unread) present

Test creates its own member via Mongo and an extra org; cleanup must be done manually (delete tickets + user_TEST_* + TEST_UnreadOrg docs in saas_* collections). Cookie banner reappears after clearing cookies and blocks sidebar footer link.
rca of the issue: Frontend build failure: Layout.jsx line 280 – the inserted unread-count useEffect was pasted over the beginning of `const multiOrg = !isSuper && ...`, leaving `}, [isSuper, user]); && (...)` -> Babel parse error. Mitigation: restored the line.
